answer: An ecology-data market assigns each reviewer a camera-trap clip only after it locks a bond. A clip may show a raven in a grove or a velvet ant on the path. Reviewers commit labels before seeing other reviewers, then reveal them with a signed frame hash from the camera. The contract pays only for accurate labels on distinct verified frames; wallets that reuse one frame split one fee, and wrong labels lose the bond. Creating more identities cannot multiply a single observation or a copied answer.
